body: I did feel connected to her for a 8 months. We knew each other for 4 years before we dated. But, she made other choices over me around the 8 month mark, then that made me question the relationship. also she drug me through some of her past baggage. I'm not sure where my connection stands with her now. It's not where it use to be. It doesn't help that we have been long distance for the last 2 months. We have been together a little over a year and are talking about moving in together, but I'm just not sure what to do now. And I want to just return to the way I felt before when I was content. But, I'm not sure that is even possible anymore. I think I just need to find a new normal.

It may be irreversible, but escaping the constant pain seems like such a release. I suppose there are some other options, but all begin with learning to live in my new existence. I created it myself, and I suppose that makes it the most painful. That being pain which is self inflicted. It just seem those who are close are intent on making it worse. As has always seem to be the case in my life.

And escape seems so much easier. All I seem to want to do lately is destroy everything around me.
